card.name: Spots just before the word salary
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation right before where "salary" or "salaries" would come in career or job-info pages. It also fires on the word Salary in labels like "Salary/Wage".

modes.label: Career data lists
modes.description: Commas, verbs or spaces in career-information text where a pay term is expected next.
modes.example: The knowledge includes occupation descriptions<<,>> salaries, like job opportunities available, details

modes.label: Job profile fields
modes.description: Spacing or label words in occupation pages that list openings and pay.

modes.label: Earning or receiving pay
modes.description: Verbs or negations right before salary in sentences about earning.
modes.example: typically<< earn>> higher salaries, and often need a bachelor

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict salary and pay words, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires when the next word is likely to be salary or pay, mostly in job and career pages.
